verdict.rationale: Probes confirm a working llms.txt at the domain root (HTTP 200) and machine-readable .md docs for the Sandbox pages, both directly agent-consumable formats, plus an OpenAPI spec for programmatic discovery. This directly satisfies pointing an agent at llms.txt/agent-oriented docs, though the llms.txt is site-wide rather than Sandbox-specific and there's no independent report of an agent actually consuming it successfully. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation of an agent successfully using llms.txt to complete a task, and a Sandbox-specific llms.txt file.
